from src.roman import int_to_roman, roman_to_int

# Test some known values
tests = [
    (1, 'I'),
    (4, 'IV'),
    (5, 'V'),
    (9, 'IX'),
    (10, 'X'),
    (40, 'XL'),
    (49, 'XLIX'),
    (90, 'XC'),
    (99, 'XCIX'),
    (100, 'C'),
    (400, 'CD'),
    (499, 'CDXCIX'),
    (958, 'CMXLVIII'),
    (1994, 'MCMXCIV'),
]

all_pass = True
for n, expected in tests:
    result = int_to_roman(n)
    if result != expected:
        print(f'FAIL: int_to_roman({n}) = {result}, expected {expected}')
        all_pass = False
    else:
        # Also verify round-trip
        back = roman_to_int(result)
        if back != n:
            print(f'FAIL: Round-trip for {n}: {result} -> {back}')
            all_pass = False

if all_pass:
    print('All tests passed!')
"
